source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 23 to 27
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 20, 2026 · 8 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler Pushka Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $11.49 Get it now Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler – November 23Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency. Build. Optimize. Relax. The Spotter: Dig or Die Forklift Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 5 ★★★★★ $12.99 Get it now The Spotter: Dig or Die – November 23XBOX Play Anywhere You’re a Spotter, the unlucky soul stationed at the worst gas station in Nevada. Your mission: hold the line against mutant hordes spilling from the ruins of Las Veganos, while awaiting a message from the President himself. But when a colossal sandstorm wrecks the base and ruins your only receiver, you lose your one chance of contact. Now everything hinges on repairing it in time. Dig by day, fight by night, and reclaim the signal before the world’s last hope is lost. Descend into a mine to scavenge for resources, discover roguelike artifacts that rewrite the rules, and turn your rusty junkyard into an impenetrable fortress in this unique hybrid of digging simulator and Tower Defense. Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party NexoriumGames ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $11.99 $9.59 Get it now Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party – November 24 Grab your friends. Lift them over your head. Throw them off a pizza rooftop. Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match. Everyone is the same jelly body in a different costume. Be a Banana, a Shark, a Hot Dog, a Ghost or a Nightstand. Punch, kick and grab. Knock a fighter dizzy, carry them to the edge while the crowd chants, and let go. Storage Hunter Simulator astragon Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now Storage Hunter Simulator – November 24 Master the art of auctions and score big against others for treasures in Storage Hunter Simulator! Stay ahead of the competition in the high-risk, high-reward world of storage auctions. Showcase your skills, win intense bidding wars and sell your hard-earned valuables to customers. Getting the best deal and maximizing your earnings is key to staying in business and building a solid reputation. Cat Mirror Tribus Games Indie ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Cat Mirror – November 25 A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at the same time, navigating complex levels where every move is mirrored. It seems easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection? Sokobear Goo Little Giant Game Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Sokobear Goo – November 25 The forest has been invaded by slime creatures, and now it’s up to Bear to help the villagers reclaim their home! Get ready for an adventure filled with puzzles, sticky monsters, and slime explosions. Explore 40 puzzle levels where every move matters. Push slime balls through the environment, plan your moves carefully, and find the right way to eliminate all the Slime Monsters. Bogos Binted GameDev.ist ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bogos Binted – November 26 Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s craziest aliens! Not every alien visits Earth to witness the indomitable human spirit. Some just want to chill on the Moon’s surface and play games. Born from the legendary internet meme, this isn’t just your average “friendslop” party game. Alien humor is… how should we put it… a bit of a brainrot. In this first-person, four-player, online multiplayer space adventure, every alien at the table must do whatever it takes to win in a variety of tabletop games. You’ll craft sneaky strategies, tell outrageous lies, pull hidden weapons, and literally blow up the heads of your so-called “friends.” Calculus of Rot Brainium Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Calculus of Rot – November 26Smart Delivery The world is dead. Mutants roam the ruins, and every step forward could be your last. Explore dark, infected zones hidden beneath the fog of war. Reveal new paths, discover useful items, and carefully decide which enemies to confront. Every encounter costs resources, and every mistake brings you closer to death. Study enemy strength, plan your route, and use your limited health and attacks wisely. Some monsters are worth the risk. Others should be avoided at all costs. As you progress, stronger abominations begin to appear, turning each map into a deadly tactical puzzle where survival depends on smart decisions rather than luck. Full Metal Sergeant 2 PolyCrunch Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Full Metal Sergeant 2 – November 26Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere If you die on the battlefield, it’s not my fault. You think boot camp’s hard? Try surviving my camp. In Full Metal Sergeant 2 you’re a hellish instructor. Your mission is to transform raw recruits into specialized war machines. Mold their minds and bodies, instill discipline, and hone their combat skills. Gravity SWlTCH Brainium Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Gravity SWITCH – November 26Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks! Step into a high-stakes sliding maze where stopping isn’t an option. In this fast-paced arcade puzzler, once you push in a direction, you slide until a wall stops you. Plan your routes, collect all the dots, and activate the warp

source.title: Once Human: Season 5 gameplay showcases co-op Colossus boss battle, live November 18
source.evidenceText: November 12, 2026November 12, 2026 Once Human: Season 5 gameplay showcases co-op Colossus boss battle, live November 18 0 0 42 Like this Starry Studio dev on weaponizing emotion and melody. Vincent Tao Lead Game Designer, Once Human What if a sky-spanning Colossus didn’t just loom overhead as a static backdrop, but actively listened and responded to your every gunshot? That’s the core question driving our upcoming fifth season, Dissonant Resonance, free to play and launching globally on November 18. Today, I want to take you behind the scenes to share how we are turning sound and emotion into your greatest weapons – and your biggest threats. New weird meets a symphony of dread Once Human thrives on the New Weird design philosophy – taking the familiar and twisting it into a nightmare. For Season 5, we wanted to apply this philosophy not just to the visuals, but to the audio itself. As we realized players always take background music for granted, we decided to weaponize it. Inspired by the cathedral pipe organ, a human symbol of sanctity and solemnity, and through the lens of the New Weird, we distorted this familiar object into a cosmic, biomechanical monstrosity: What if the music wasn’t just playing in your headset, but was the literal breathing and judgment of a cosmic monstrosity watching your every move? This idea birthed the Sky Living-Machine Colossus. By merging the sacred with the grotesque, this massive pipe-organ titan transforms the very rhythm of the world into an active, weaponized mechanic. Emotion zones & rhythmic gunplay To ground this massive concept in actual gameplay, we’ve warped the open world with four distinct Emotion Zones: Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Fear. In these erratic regions, your arsenal becomes an instrument. Defeating enemies scatters musical notes across the battlefield. By shooting these notes, you not only trigger pitch-tuned audio to improvise your own battle rhythms, but also collect them to purify dissonant, corrupted scores. Once these notes are rearranged into harmonious melodies, the scores grant your squad powerful rewards. And as you perform these deadly battle rhythms, the Sky Colossus above will react dynamically, shifting its visual expressions in real-time. Once the Sky Colossus descends and lingers long enough, the world itself splits open—a rift portal emerges, daring your squad to step through and face the music directly. Conducting the Colossus & a new companion Stepping through that portal initiates a high-stakes, four-player co-op Colossus Raid. But this is no traditional boss fight. Taking center stage, the titan becomes a maestro of destruction, dynamically shifting the battlefield’s combat score. As the boss and the arena pulse to a new rhythm, your squad must adapt on the fly. You need to sprint to silence glowing resonating pipes in a ruined cathedral, and disrupt the melody before the deadly track concludes. You aren’t just surviving a boss fight – you are conducting it. To help you survive this apocalyptic symphony, we are also introducing the brand-new Deviant, Silent Statue. Appearing initially as a shattered, gray monument, it silently absorbs the elemental chaos of your firefights. For those who can unlock its true potential, the ruins will mend and spread brilliant golden wings—bestowing a massive elemental blessing across the squad. Gear up, tune your weapons, and get ready to conduct the apocalypse when Once Human Season 5: Dissonant Resonance drops November 18 on PS5! Once HumanStarry Studio Did you like this?
